analysis.original_request: 我负责星载量子密钥分发接收机前端防护窗口的研发。接收机需要尽可能完整地接收 1530–1565 nm 电信波段的单光子信号，同时尽可能反射 400–700 nm 波段的可见光太阳背景，以降低空间太阳散射和探测器杂散光对量子信号接收的影响。请在空气入射、熔融石英基底的条件下，仅使用 HfO2 和 SiO2 设计一个平面多层介质膜，膜系总层数不超过 30 层。
analysis.normalized_request_english: I am responsible for the R&D of the protective window for the front-end of a satellite-based quantum key distribution receiver. The receiver needs to receive 1530-1565 nm telecom band single-photon signals as completely as possible, while reflecting 400-700 nm visible light solar background as much as possible to reduce the impact of space solar scattering and detector stray light on quantum signal reception. Please design a planar multilayer dielectric film using only HfO2 and SiO2 under conditions of unspecified material incidence and fused silica substrate, with a total stack layer count not exceeding 30 layers.
analysis.compatibility_reason: Request specifies planar multilayer dielectric film with isotropic materials under plane-wave illumination, fitting the TMM solver scope.
method_research_questions: Optimal layer thickness distribution to achieve dual-band spectral separation
